continuing_research.scope: Oracle AArch64 isolated HTTP research after the frozen H2 confirmation. H2 canonical identity, validation and three-side router results above remain unchanged; these later candidates have no claimed canonical or router acceptance.
continuing_research.profile_method: Release profiler, 100 warm-up calls per stage, then 1000 timed calls; allocation counters are enabled for one separate invocation. ns_per_op is local stage wall time, not HTTP daemon CPU or an end-to-end performance claim. Reply shape stages listed here start with output capacity 128; final buffers remain separate from the instrumented server screens.
continuing_research.screen_method: Plain HTTP namespace loopback; exact image C ubusd/rpcd dependencies. Two independent windows per side, 4000 measured requests per workload; c1 warm-up 20, c4 warm-up 20 per client. Per-run metrics and every slower tail are preserved. These are descriptive screens, not a statistical-significance or equivalence test.
